name: lexyns-clean
description: Lexyns Clean, Sibiu. Site static cu editor pentru client (Cloudflare Pages, D1, publicare în GitHub).

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 5173
scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check admin.js && node --check content-schema.js && node --check content-renderer.js && node --check media-prepare.js && node --check cloudflare/worker.js && node --check cloudflare/editor-api.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/serve.mjs && node --check scripts/render.mjs && node --check scripts/admin-password.mjs && node --check scripts/build-media.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
